construction_catalog.scope: Adjective preceded by the taught definite article/demonstrative in the noun phrase; complete weak endings must be taught before use.
Adjective predicate agrees with subject in gender/number/case and is strong; do not mistake an article on the subject for an article governing the predicate adjective.

Ordinals use weak inflection regardless of the presence of the article, except ōðer.
ōðer uses strong inflection despite the article; selected feminine nominative ōðru with endingless ōðer accepted.
